hero.title: A production-aligned Service Desk prototype centered on explicit workflow, routing, and audit history.

description.local: Local Demo runs the implemented ticket and settings workflows through mutable demo state. ADMIN has broad access, while non-ADMIN commands are authorized from the user's relationship to each ticket.
description.remote: The REMOTE data boundary implements the major Service Desk workflows with server-only services and PostgreSQL. Direct Service Desk page access remains limited in the hosted remote mode.

about.title: Current implementation
about.description: The portal keeps one feature-facing contract while selecting LOCAL or REMOTE execution at the server boundary.

description.local: LOCAL provides resettable, server-side demo state for ticket search, drafts, commands, history, work sessions, and tenant-scoped settings. It preserves the feature API contract without claiming persistence equivalence with PostgreSQL.
description.remote: REMOTE uses server-only data services, repositories, row mappers, DTOs, and PostgreSQL for the implemented ticket and settings workflows. The hosted remote account still has guarded access to Service Desk pages.

local.note1: The UI calls feature API clients and Next.js Route Handlers; runtime-specific behavior stays in LOCAL adapters or REMOTE data services.
local.note2: Tickets use explicit statuses and server-controlled commands for approval, assignment, work, resolution, and close transitions.
local.note3: LOCAL state is intentionally demo-safe and resettable. It mirrors observable contracts where implemented, not the durability of REMOTE persistence.

remote.note1: REMOTE persists tickets, drafts, settings, actions, history, and work sessions through server-only PostgreSQL boundaries.
remote.note2: Operational commands coordinate ticket mutation, action persistence, and immutable history; settings tree writes validate references transactionally.
remote.note3: The hosted route guard limits direct Service Desk UI access in REMOTE mode even though the underlying major workflow boundaries are implemented.
